item.title: THE STRANGERS: CHAPTER 3 Reviews Earn Slasher Threequel Franchise-Low Rotten Tomatoes Score
item.description: The review embargo has now lifted for Lionsgate's The Strangers: Chapter 3, and the critics have not been kind to Renny Harlin's slasher threequel...

item.title: WOLVERINE: Is Insomniac Teasing An Appearance From Daredevil In Upcoming Video Game?
item.description: Marvel fans remain desperate for a Daredevil video game, and a recent social post from Insomniac promoting this fall's Wolverine may be hinting at plans for the Man Without Fear.

item.title: BALDUR'S GATE 3 Is Getting A Sequel Series On HBO From The LAST OF US's Craig Mazin
item.description: The Last of Us co-creator Craig Mazin is returning to HBO for another video game adaptation, but this time, it will be a direct sequel...to 2023's hit Baldur's Gate 3.

item.title: PREY Director Dan Trachtenberg Signs 3-Year Deal With Paramount - What Does This Mean For PREDATOR Franchise?
item.description: 10 Cloverfield Lane director Dan Trachtenberg has returned to the studio he began his career at, signing a first-look, three-year deal with Paramount Pictures...

item.title: AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY Star Chris Hemsworth Reveals New Thor Details: "[He's] One Of The Elders"
item.description: Chris Hemsworth has revealed new details about Thor's evolution in Avengers: Doomsday, explaining that we find the God of Thunder at a much different point in his 2000+ year life.

item.title: MASTERS OF THE UNIVERSE Star Idris Elba Is He-Man's Man-At-Arms In Must-See New Still
item.description: A new look at the live-action Masters of the Universe reboot puts the spotlight on Idris Elba's Man-At-Arms, but what about the movie is Nicholas Galitzine comparing to a sex scene?

item.title: THE MUMMY Star Oded Fehr Reveals Whether He's Been Contacted About Upcoming Sequel (Exclusive)
item.description: Talking to us about his role in Grizzly Night, actor Oded Fehr opens up on possibly reprising his role as Ardeth Bay in The Mummy 4, starring Brendan Fraser and Rachel Weisz.

item.title: AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY Doctor Doom Promo Art May Confirm Authenticity Of Previous Costume Leak
item.description: An Avengers: Doomsday crew gift reveals a new look at Robert Downey Jr.'s Doctor Doom, potentially confirming the authenticity of those leaked cast photos most fans initially dismissed as AI.

item.title: MASTERS OF THE UNIVERSE's Skeletor Nearly Looked Much Different; Will Be "Embodiment Of Toxic Masculinity"
item.description: Masters of the Universe director Travis Knight reveals how different Jared Leto's Skeletor looked in earlier drafts of the script and expains how the actor has approached this take on the villain.
